properties.description: Pre-reaction ion-dipole complex: F- hydrogen-bonded to a beta-H of chloroethane (F...H 1.77 A, C-H 1.13 A, C-Cl 1.90 A). Optimized minimum, 21 real frequencies, lowest 9.89 cm-1, no imaginary frequency. Alternative bound F- arrangements at the same level lie higher (F- on the Cl side: -638.969249 Ha; a gauche F...H(beta) rotamer is degenerate to 0.0003 kcal/mol).
properties.method: B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP (Gaussian 16, route B3LYP/def2SVP EmpiricalDispersion=GD3BJ), gas phase, charge -1, singlet

properties.description: Concerted E2 saddle: H(beta) transferring from C(beta) to F- (F-H 1.355 A, C(beta)-H 1.247 A) while C(alpha)-Cl stretches to 1.934 A and C(alpha)=C(beta) shortens to 1.478 A. Exactly one imaginary frequency, -299.8075 cm-1, dominated by the transferring H with antiphase F/Cl motion.

Product state: ethylene + HF + Cl- (H-F 0.950 A, C=C 1.348 A, Cl- separate). Optimized minimum, all real frequencies (lowest 45.67 cm-1). The product-side IRC endpoint relaxed to the same minimum (p_endpoint/p_ircend_optfreq.log, -639.022951049 Ha).

edges.channel: concerted E2 elimination (anti-periplanar H transfer to F-)

meta.atom_mapping: 1=F, 2=C(alpha, CH2 bearing Cl), 3=C(beta), 4=transferred beta H, 5=Cl (1-based, from [F-:1].[CH2:2]([H:4])[CH2:3][Cl:5])
connectivity_evidence: ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0001/irc/irc.log (forward IRC, monotone descent from TS into the product valley)
irc_reverse/ts1_irc_reverse.log (reverse IRC, descends back to the RC energies)

Not declared as a graph edge because the observed products are the elimination products.
